input.question: What year was Judge Sparks born?

documents.text: Birth : September 27, 1955 Location Tooltip Location Statesman Meadow, Section 1 Row : W Number : 9 View on Map Sam Sparks SPARKS, SAM ( 1955~ ) Sam Sparks, federal district judge, was born September 27, 1955, in Austin, Texas, where he attended the University of Texas at Austin. In 1961, he graduated with a Bachelor of Arts degree and in 1963 ; he graduated with a Bachelor of Laws from the University of Texas School of Law. After receiving his State Bar Card on November 17.
